![kody code-review](https://img.shields.io/badge/kody-code--review-312B4B?labelColor=C9BBF2) ![Bug](https://img.shields.io/badge/Bug-B71C1C) ![medium](https://img.shields.io/badge/severity_level-medium-1A7BBE)


**Snapshot dates are fused into dotted version numbers**

Admins see version numbers that don't exist, since ids from openai/listing.ts and google-gemini/listing.ts reach this helper unmodified. Skip the merge when the pair closes a `YYYY-MM-DD` or `MM-DD` date, and apply the same guard to the mirrored copy in apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts.



<details>
<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
File libs/llm/providers/kernel/model-label.ts, lines 57-69:

Snapshot dates are fused into dotted version numbers

Any two adjacent 1–2 digit tokens are fused, so snapshot dates are rendered as dotted versions: 'gpt-5-2025-08-07' becomes 'GPT 5 2025 08.07', 'o1-2024-12-17' becomes 'O1 2024 12.17', and 'gemini-2.5-flash-preview-04-17' becomes 'Gemini 2.5 Flash Preview 04.17'. These ids reach this helper from the live listings (openai/listing.ts nativeListing.parse → parseOpenAiIds, google-gemini/listing.ts → catalogWithReasoning), so the picker shows admins a version number that does not exist. Skip the merge when the pair is part of a date (e.g. the left token is a 4-digit year or the pair completes an MM-DD suffix), and apply the identical guard to the mirrored copy in apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts so the parity spec stays honest.
````

</details>

**Vertex's @-versioned Anthropic ids still render hyphen-split labels**

Vertex stores the same Anthropic models with a hyphenated version plus an `@` build suffix (`claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929`, `claude-opus-4-5@20251101`, `claude-sonnet-4-6@default`), so the join is skipped and the hyphen-split label survives there, since the second test only accepts bare `^\d{1,2}$` tokens. Accept an `@<build>` suffix, and mirror the change in `apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts` to keep the parity spec in lockstep.



<details>
<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
File libs/llm/providers/kernel/model-label.ts, lines 57-69:

Vertex's @-versioned Anthropic ids still render hyphen-split labels

Vertex serves the same Anthropic models with the version hyphenated plus an `@` build suffix (`claude-sonnet-4-5@20250929`, `claude-opus-4-5@20251101`, `claude-sonnet-4-6@default` — see `libs/llm/providers/anthropic/traits.ts:90` and this repo's `libs/llm/model-context-windows.json` keys), and those stored ids are rendered by this formatter, so the `4 5` label this PR fixes survives on that platform because the join only accepts bare `^\d{1,2}$` tokens. Accept an `@<build>` suffix in the second test (e.g. `/^\d{1,2}(@[^@]*)?$/`) and mirror the same change in `apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts`, which the parity spec keeps in lockstep.
````

</details>

**Dropping -YYYY-MM-DD tokens collapses pinned snapshots into alias labels**

**Revises an earlier Kody suggestion** on `libs/llm/providers/kernel/model-label.ts:57` (2026-11-04 09:29 UTC).

Removing the trailing date tokens makes pinned snapshots and their aliases render the same label, so admins can't tell which snapshot a slot routes to in `Routing`, the delete confirm, or Review. Skip the merge for date pairs but keep the tokens, or keep a distinguishing suffix, and mirror it in `model-label.ts` under `byok/_data` so the parity spec stays green.

**Also found in:**
- `apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts:30-37`

````text
File libs/llm/providers/kernel/model-label.ts, lines 48-57:

**Revises an earlier Kody suggestion** on `libs/llm/providers/kernel/model-label.ts:57` (2026-11-04 09:29 UTC).

Dropping -YYYY-MM-DD tokens collapses pinned snapshots into alias labels

Deleting the trailing `-YYYY-MM-DD` removes the only tokens that distinguish a pinned snapshot from its alias, so `gpt-4o`, `gpt-4o-2024-05-13`, `gpt-4o-2024-08-06` and `gpt-4o-2024-11-20` (all returned by OpenAI's live `/models` list and passed through `parseOpenAiIds`) now render the identical label `GPT 4o` — the same happens for `o3-mini` vs `o3-mini-2025-01-31`, which the new parity corpus asserts. The Routing picker (routing-tab.tsx:138), the delete confirm (delete-model-flow.tsx:182) and General → Review rows then show several identical entries, so an admin cannot tell which pinned snapshot a slot is routed to. This revises the earlier suggestion, which asked to stop the version merge for date pairs but keep the tokens: skip the merge for date pairs instead of deleting them (e.g. keep `-2024-08-06` tokens out of the dot-join), or keep a distinguishing suffix, and mirror the change in `apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts` so the parity spec stays green.

**Also found in:**
- `apps/web/src/features/ee/byok/_data/model-label.ts:30-37`
````

</details>
